assumptions: One unit record per allocation component (XDL1-SR-001-U .. XDL1-SR-019-U with component_id XDL1-SR-001-CMP .. XDL1-SR-019-CMP) follows the accepted T027/T038 precedent and keeps later decomposes_to/implemented_by/verified_by/analyzed_by links unambiguous; decomposes_to links XDL1-L-201 .. XDL1-L-219 were appended additively to engineering/trace/links.json.

The successor unit records preserve all 102 predecessor case identifiers verbatim and add 19 case identifiers (3 for XDL1-RVW-002 in XDL1-SR-002-U, 1 limitation-count negative in XDL1-SR-012-U, 15 count-based bound cases in XDL1-SR-019-U), giving 121 frozen pytest identifiers; no predecessor identifier was renamed, dropped or weakened.

Planned unit-case identifiers are full pytest node identifiers of the form tests/thesis_lite/xdl/test_xdl1_<area>_unit.py::test_<case>. They contain no hyphen, so trusted discovery normalization test_id.replace('-','_') is a no-op and each identifier appears verbatim in verbose pytest output for the unit measure.

Tests are planned as module-level functions (not classes) so the printed node identifier is exactly the recorded one; the planned package markers tests/thesis_lite/__init__.py and tests/thesis_lite/xdl/__init__.py and the neutral fixtures under tests/thesis_lite/xdl/fixtures/ are created by the implementation stage.

Defect classes that the accepted loader/schema gate rejects before the compiler runs (unknown namespace, unknown payload field, oversized file) keep their accepted XDL-* code; defect classes the accepted core does not reject (missing/duplicate/out-of-range seed, value-type or bound violation, unresolved time mapping on the normalized path, declared entity and parameter count bounds) are stated with the frozen XDL1-PLAN-* code.

ExperimentLimits.max_diagnostics is interpreted as detailed-design.md section 10.2 declares: the compiler retains at most max_diagnostics returned diagnostics and fails closed with no plan. detailed-design.md section 9 assigns no separate diagnostic code to the diagnostic-count scope, so the case asserts the bounded diagnostics list plus plan is None and no new code is invented.

ExperimentLimits.max_bytes_per_file mirrors the accepted LoadLimits byte bound and is enforced on the load path by the accepted parser, so its negative case is exercised through compile_experiment_files and expects the accepted XDL-PARSE-TOO-LARGE code; the compiler core never receives source bytes and performs no byte check.

The declared-core max_parameters scope is owned by XDL1-SR-019-U (bounds) even though the projection itself is XDL1-SR-002-U; this keeps each unit record's error surface consistent with its own component record, and avoids attributing XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED to the frozen XDL1-SR-002-CMP record whose error list does not carry it.

Unit expectations contain only platform library bounds, frozen constants and declared caller values; no thesis protocol number, threshold, tolerance or seed appears anywhere in the unit specification.
The static checks recorded per unit are planned inputs to the XDL1-STATIC static_analysis measure owned by the verification-design stage; no static analysis is executed in this stage.

engineering/trace/links.json is a mutable additive trace file; it is not listed as an immutable artifact of this stage, and this stage appended only 19 decomposes_to links while preserving all 3063 pre-existing links and their endpoint revisions.
No implementation, schema, fixture or test code was written; the precode gate requires the unit-specification and verification-design stages to complete before implementation.
